service.description: The working schedules the caller reads (a staff reader the schedules of their employers, a manager those their live reports follow now or later), by name or id (term, ignoring case), of an employer (organizationPartyId; ORGANIZATION_DENIED outside the scope), those in effect on asOfDate (now when empty) unless includeEnded. Each with its employer, zone, holiday calendar, weekly hours (the lines in effect, by the clock), dates and state, how many employments follow it now or later (for an HR reader), whether the caller may change it and its revision. Paged. Refuses a caller who reads no employer or team (PERMISSION_DENIED).

service.description: One working schedule the caller reads: its row as find#Schedules gives it with whether anyone has followed it (assignedEver: its zone no longer changes) and whether the caller assigns it; its lines (every dated line, those in effect on asOfDate first: now, or the schedule's start when it starts later), each with its day, local start and end (nextDay when it ends the next day), break, hours, dates and state; and who follows it now or later (assignmentsShown: an HR reader of its employer sees every one, a manager their reports), each with the person, the employment, the dates, the holiday calendar in place of the schedule's and the employment's revision. Refuses one outside the scope as missing (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

A new working schedule of an employer (organizationPartyId, an HR editor's) from fromDate (today when empty): its name, time zone (an IANA name), holiday calendar (the employer's or a shared one) and description; with copyFromScheduleId (a schedule the caller reads), a copy: a new schedule with that one's zone, calendar and the lines it has in effect on the new one's start unless given. Or a change of one at its revision (expectedRevision): its name, description and holiday calendar (holidayCategoryId_changeReason is changeReason), its zone while no one has followed it, and with end, its end from thruDate (today or later). Needs PEOPLE_HR_VIEW and PEOPLE_HR_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED). Refuses: ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED, ORGANIZATION_DENIED, NAME_REQUIRED, ZONE_INVALID, CALENDAR_UNAVAILABLE, a schedule outside the scope (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), REVISION_CHANGED, another employer (OWNER_CHANGE), a zone change once followed (ZONE_IN_USE), an end before today (DATE_PAST) or while an employment follows it after the end (SCHEDULE_ASSIGNED).

A weekly interval of a schedule at its revision (expectedRevision): added from fromDate (empty: today, or the schedule's start when later), changed from fromDate (before the line's start in place; after it the line ends then and another starts with the new values, so a past week keeps its hours) or, with end, ended from fromDate (on or before its start, it never took effect). isoDay is 1 Monday to 7 Sunday; startTime and endTime are HH:mm local times in the schedule's zone, an end at or before the start ending the next day; breakMinutes is the unpaid break. Needs PEOPLE_HR_VIEW and PEOPLE_HR_EDIT of the schedule's employer (PERMISSION_DENIED; RECORD_UNAVAILABLE outside the scope). Refuses: REVISION_CHANGED, DAY_INVALID, TIME_INVALID, BREAK_INVALID (not shorter than the interval), OVERLAP (another line in effect then overlaps it, across midnight and the week's end too), DATE_OUTSIDE (the schedule has ended), DATE_PAST (a date before today on a schedule anyone has followed: the weeks planned by it stay as they were), LINE_ENDED.

An employment follows a working schedule from fromDate (the start of today when empty, or of the employment or its assignment when either began later today), with holidayCategoryId in place of the schedule's holiday calendar when given; an empty workingScheduleId ends the following of one. Applied at once by an HR editor of the employer, a change of its own (EmploymentChange of kind EckSchedule, with its reason and operation key, a retry answering the first): the assignment in effect ends on the date and the next starts with the other terms as they were (an employment written before People's assignments gets its first; from the day the assignment in effect starts, a hire's first day, that assignment's schedule changes in place), so a later transfer carries the schedule; a transfer or separation of the employment waiting for approval stays waiting with its approval (the approvers notified again) and takes the schedule in effect on its date; withdrawn by withdraw#EmploymentChange while its date is to come. expectedRevision, when given, is the employment's. Needs PEOPLE_HR_VIEW and PEOPLE_HR_EDIT (PERMISSION_DENIED). Refuses: an employment outside the scope (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), REVISION_CHANGED, DATE_OUTSIDE, ASSIGNMENT_SCHEDULED (a later change is set; choose a later date), CHANGE_WAITING (a transfer or separation from that date or earlier waits for approval), a schedule of another employer (SCHEDULE_OUTSIDE) or not in effect on the date (SCHEDULE_NOT_IN_EFFECT), CALENDAR_UNAVAILABLE, SCHEDULE_REQUIRED (a calendar with no schedule), NOTHING_CHANGES.

The holiday calendars a staff reader reads (shared ones, and their employers' own; organizationPartyId narrows to that employer's and the shared ones, ORGANIZATION_DENIED outside the scope), each with its employer (or Shared), the number of its holidays from fromDate through thruDate (this year when empty), whether the caller may change it and its revision; and the holidays of those days of holidayCategoryId (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE when not read) or of every calendar listed, by day, each with its name, calendar, whether it has passed, whether the caller may change it and its revision. Refuses a caller who reads no employer (PERMISSION_DENIED).

A new holiday calendar (a WorkEffortCategory of type WcatHoliday) of an employer (organizationPartyId) or, with none, shared by every employer, or a calendar's new name at its revision (expectedRevision). No employer follows a calendar until a schedule (or an assignment) names it. Needs PEOPLE_HR_VIEW and PEOPLE_HR_EDIT of the employer (PERMISSION_DENIED, ORGANIZATION_DENIED); a shared calendar PEOPLE_ALL_ORGANIZATIONS too. Refuses NAME_REQUIRED, a calendar the caller does not change (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), REVISION_CHANGED.

A holiday added to a calendar the caller changes (holidayCategoryId): an all-day WepHoliday WorkEffort named workEffortName on holidayDate, in the calendar, with no owner (so only the schedules that name the calendar take the day, not every employee of an organization); or a holiday's new name or day at its revision (expectedRevision); or with remove, a holiday removed. Needs PEOPLE_HR_VIEW and PEOPLE_HR_EDIT of the calendar's employer (a shared calendar PEOPLE_ALL_ORGANIZATIONS too). Refuses: a calendar or holiday the caller does not change (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), NAME_REQUIRED, DATE_REQUIRED, DAY_TAKEN (the calendar has a holiday that day), REVISION_CHANGED, HOLIDAY_PAST (a holiday whose day has passed stays as it was, and none is added on or moves to a past day).

A person's capacity from fromDate through thruDate (today and the next 13 days when empty; at most 62 days) as Projects and timesheets read it (mantle.work.ResourceServices.get#PartyCapacity): where the hours come from (source: schedule, available or policy, and sourceText), each day's planned hours, holiday, leave, capacity and the schedule that planned it, and the weeks. For an HR reader of an employer of the person or their manager; anyone else is refused alike (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE). Refuses DATES_INVALID.
